question: ¿En cuántos ensayos de cáncer de próstata se prueba al menos un fármaco aprobado cuyo target es el receptor de andrógenos (gen AR)?

attempts.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT td.nct_id)
FROM linking.trial_drug td
JOIN linking.drug d ON d.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = d.chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id
WHERE d.approved AND tg.gene_symbol = 'AR' AND md.label = 'Prostatic Neoplasms'
